topic: Ignoring an impounded car vs enforcing towing recovery rights (Zane vs Sabine)

scenes.narration: His towed car got auctioned off while storage fees quietly exploded. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside an impounded car under an auction sign while storage fees stack up, comic burst banner reads AUCTIONED OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zane and Sabine both have their cars towed one night.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man zane and woman sabine in the courtroom, each watching tow trucks haul away their cars at night, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Towing companies must post fees and follow strict notice rules.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing rule book on the courtroom bench labeled POSTED FEES AND NOTICE RULES, a tow truck icon beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zane ignores the impound lot, dreading the mounting recovery costs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man zane turning away from an impound lot gate, dreading a rising cost meter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Daily storage fees pile up fast while he does nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a car in an impound lot with a daily fee counter climbing higher, man zane doing nothing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sabine acts fast and requests the posted impound fee schedule.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman sabine at the impound office requesting a paper labeled FEE SCHEDULE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She disputes the wrongful tow and retrieves her personal belongings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman sabine filing a form stamped WRONGFUL TOW DISPUTE and carrying out her belongings box, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sabine pays under protest, keeping receipts to challenge the charges.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman sabine paying at a counter with a receipt stamped PAID UNDER PROTEST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Weeks later, Zane's car is sold at a lien auction.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man zane's car on an auction block, a gavel and a sign reads LIEN AUCTION SOLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He loses the car and still owes the leftover balance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man zane with no car, holding a bill labeled LEFTOVER BALANCE OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sabine recovers her car and wins back the wrongful fees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman sabine driving away in her recovered car, a refund slip stamped WRONGFUL FEES RETURNED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Act fast on an impound, get the fee schedule, dispute wrongful tows. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads ACT FAST GET THE FEE SCHEDULE, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
